tasks.title: The first coroutine
tasks.statement: Write a coroutine add_later(a, b, delay=0.01): it waits delay seconds (asyncio.sleep) and returns a + b.

tasks.title: All at once
tasks.statement: Write a coroutine fetch_all(delays): for each delay in the list it starts a coroutine that waits that many seconds and returns the string «готово <i>» (i is the index from zero). All the waits must run simultaneously (gather); the results are in list order.
tasks.hint: Define a nested async def one(i, d): await asyncio.sleep(d); return `f'готово {i}'`, and return await asyncio.gather(*(one(i, d) for i, d in enumerate(delays))).

tasks.title: A time limit
tasks.statement: Write a coroutine with_timeout(coro, seconds): it waits for the result of coro for no longer than seconds seconds; if it does not finish in time, it returns the string «таймаут».
tasks.hint: try: return await asyncio.wait_for(coro, seconds) / except TimeoutError: return `'таймаут'`.

tasks.title: Results and errors
tasks.statement: Write a coroutine run_safely(coros): it runs the coroutines concurrently and returns a list in the original order: ('ok', value) for successful ones and ('error', text) for failed ones. Use gather with return_exceptions=True.
tasks.hint: results = await asyncio.gather(*coros, return_exceptions=True); exceptions are instances of BaseException.

tasks.title: No more than N at a time
tasks.statement: Write a coroutine bounded_gather(funcs, limit): funcs is a list of functions with no arguments, each returning a coroutine. Run them concurrently, but so that no more than limit run at the same time (asyncio.Semaphore). Return the results in the original order.
tasks.hint: sem = asyncio.Semaphore(limit); async def run(f): async with sem: return await f(); then gather(*(run(f) for f in funcs)).

tasks.title: An asynchronous generator
tasks.statement: Write an asynchronous generator async_range(n, delay): it yields the numbers from 0 to n - 1, waiting delay seconds (asyncio.sleep) before each one.
tasks.hint: An async def with yield inside: for i in range(n): await asyncio.sleep(delay); yield i.

tasks.title: A worker pool
tasks.statement: Write a coroutine process_all(items, workers): put items into an asyncio.Queue and process them with workers worker coroutines (each takes a job, waits 0.01 s and puts the square into the result). Return the sorted list of squares. Stop the workers when done.
tasks.hint: workers = [asyncio.create_task(worker()) ...]; await q.join(); then cancel() the workers.

tasks.title: Retries
tasks.statement: Write a coroutine retry(make_coro, attempts, delay=0.01): it calls make_coro() (which returns a coroutine), and if that fails with an exception, waits delay and tries again, attempts times in total. If all attempts fail, it raises the last exception.
tasks.hint: for i in range(attempts): try: return await make_coro() / except Exception as e: last = e; await asyncio.sleep(delay); after the loop, raise last.
